description: Hundreds of people left work in the middle of a weekday to pack the Conservation Club in Dunkirk for Bruce Blakeman on Monday.That tells you everything you need to know. You could feel the energy in the room. It came from people who are hungry for change. People are tired. They are tired of high taxes. They are tired of feeling unsafe.
